subject: Human Evolution
title: Shrinking Teeth and Jaws
description: A fast breakdown of Shrinking Teeth and Jaws for builders.

hook.text: Australopithecus had massive molars for grinding tough plants. Yours are tiny. What happened?

buildup.text: Over two million years, hominin teeth steadily shrank. Jaw muscles weakened and faces flattened.

discovery.text: Cooking softened food, reducing the need for heavy chewing—so big teeth lost their advantage.

twist.text: Smaller jaw muscles may have relaxed skull constraints, allowing the braincase to expand.

climax.text: Your flat face and small teeth are not just modern style—they're evolutionary results of cooking.

quiz.question: Why did human teeth and jaws shrink over time?
options: Cooking softened food, reducing chewing demands
